rule: Landblock load places one weenie per encounter row at cell_x*24, cell_y*24 (clamped 0.5..191.5), destroys it if the cell has a building. Generator tick rolls one profile by cumulative probability (-1 = always) among profiles not maxed and available, queues the spawn, spawns on the next heartbeat. A member removed by the profile's WhenCreate event makes that profile unavailable for Delay seconds (chest = 0; else profile delay, falling back to profile 0). When the count reaches zero and automatic destruction is set, the generator destroys itself, with no grace timer. Global override (off by default) flattens every profile's regen interval and delay.

look_test: Sandbox zone with three camp points (three members, one leader), two patrol points, one self-destructing camp. Respawn 60 s and grace 10 s first, then 300 s. Dom walks it for five minutes at 375 wide: does a camp read as one group; does a cleared camp show a visible gap not a pop; does an emptied camp leave cleanly. Our values, not donor values.
